exposure: Fetal weight extremes (very low or very high birth weights)
Examiner experience (trained ultrasound examiners, other examiners)
cohort: 204 singleton pregnancies between 37 weeks of gestation and 12 days post-term planned for vaginal delivery or cesarean section
finding: Fetal weight was most accurately assessed with ultrasound performed by trained examiners.
mod_finding: At term, fetal weight estimation is an important factor for decisions about the delivery mode.
gest_age: 37 weeks of gestation to 12 days post-term
